about:
Apollo Electric was founded in 1995 by George Wasilewski in New York City. After moving from Poland, Wasilewski started a small residential electrical business with a vision rooted in reputation, trust, and long-term relationships. The company is headquartered in New York, New York, and remains founder-led.

The firm provides high-end electrical contracting services for luxury residential and commercial projects. Its scope includes installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical panels, lighting fixtures, wiring, and outlets, as well as integration of advanced lighting control systems such as Lutron HomeWorks QS, Eco-System, and wireless solutions. Apollo also installs EV charging infrastructure and audio-visual systems, and operates a dedicated 24/7 service division staffed by licensed master electricians. In-house accounting, coordination, and estimating departments support project execution across multiple states, with satellite offices in Florida, Connecticut, California (as AE Electric), Texas, and Nevada, plus a traveling team for national projects.

Apollo serves architects, developers, and general contractors in high-end single-family residential construction, luxury retail, hospitality, office, healthcare, and multifamily developments. Notable projects include the Porsche Tower Residences and flagship stores for Gucci, Celine, Rolex, and Tiffany & Co., as well as hospitality venues such as Four Seasons Restaurants, Carbone, Delilah, 40/40 Club, Eataly, and Catch.

The company was built on a vision of excellence and lasting relationships, emphasizing technical mastery, discretion, and craftsmanship. Its differentiators include round-the-clock service availability, integrated in-house project management divisions, and specialization in sophisticated lighting control and automation platforms.
